entities.summary: Thanos Mikroutsikos (b. 1947-04-13, Patras) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Patras and Greece. Known in the fields of greece, composers & musicians, europe.
